entities.name: Vasiliy Rakov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vasily Ivanovich Rakov was a pilot in the Soviet Naval Aviation who was twice awarded the title Hero of the Soviet Union in 1940 and 1945 for his actions in the Winter War and World War II respectively; afterward, he remained in the military, reaching the rank of Major-General.
